verdict_rule: l1>l0 if min(l1) > max(l0); l1<l0 if max(l1) < min(l0); indistinguishable otherwise (ADR 0008, over ALL per-run medians each side — this run's R and the committed L0 baseline's R, which differ: R=10 vs R=5)
claimability_rule: ADR 0007 (fixed before L1): a between-level finding is claimable only if |effect| >= 10x the cell's committed instrument p99 error (results/instrument/validation.json). Every cell x metric verdict is computed and recorded by the mechanical ADR 0008 sign rule; at a sub-bar margin it sits at the instrument's resolution and flips between fresh runs by design (2026-10-10: c=1 TTFT, 0.012 ms). The gate checks the claimable set; the sub-bar set is reported as information. Restricting claims to effects above the instrument's error is the option ADR 0007 sanctions.
